sql: select (select count(*) from experiment_deployment_arms eda join experiment_deployments ed on ed.id=eda.deployment_id where eda.strategy_tag='mmsell10' and ed.ended_at is null) as active_arms, (select count(*) from paper_trades where strategy='mmsell10' and created_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-02 01:28:57+00' and status in ('settled','closed_sl','closed_tp','closed_timeout')) as settled_since_v2, (select count(*) from paper_trades where strategy='mmsell10' and created_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-02 01:28:57+00') as created_since_v2, (select count(*) from mmsell_candidate_ticks where captured_at > now() - interval '10 minutes') as cands_10m, (select max(started_at)::text from bot_runs) as last_boot, now()::text as now_utc
